# Capability matrix

<!-- Generated by tests/mode_matrix.cpp from supports() (src/core/src/supports.cpp); do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: build/tests/mode_matrix --write docs/mode-matrix.md (ctest's mode_matrix_check fails when it is stale). -->

What works in a document of each depth and colour mode, as the menus, tools and automation gate it ([bit-depth.md](bit-depth.md), [color-modes.md](color-modes.md)). CMYK and Lab exist at 8 and 16 bits only, as in Photoshop.

- **native**: works on the document's own samples.
- **native\*** : works, but some of its pixels are made in RGB and converted (the note says which).
- **greyed (Photoshop lacks)**: Photoshop has no such feature in that mode or depth; greyed for good ("Not available in 32-bit mode", "Not available in CMYK mode").
- **greyed (not yet)**: waiting for a port ("... yet").
